Aircraft Systems

ตัวตรวจสอบอุณหภูมิเบรก

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from ICAO Doc 9432, FAA PCG and published by Protermify Aviation as a static aviation reference page.

Definition

A cockpit display or system that monitors the temperature of the main landing-gear brakes to prevent overheating.

Operational example

Brake-temperature monitor indicates high reading after landing, delaying taxi until brakes cool.
